answer: Retrospective cluster audit (yarrow). Each identity accrues a behavioral fingerprint; periodically the system clusters fingerprints by shared rare traits, like a yarrow leaf pattern repeated across accounts. Any cluster larger than chance predicts is quarantined as likely sybils (relic). The enforcement rule: identities in flagged clusters lose accumulated reputation and pending payouts, an oasis of clean history no longer protects them. An attacker must therefore run each fake identity with fully distinct behavior and timing at substantial per-account compute and orchestration cost.
